scope: 803 Real +767 Render, exact official test questions/reference, original prompt, BF16 base +FP32 unmerged LoRA, greedy1024, A10. Baseline already reproduced onA10; compare16 fresh-natural baseline generations as reproducibility probe against original full predictions.
batching: Concatenate official Real then Render order. Five fixed chunks of320 (last290). Each paid job has explicit hard timeout no greater1800s and soft child-process deadline100s earlier; fsync resume and commit partial results. No parallel GPU jobs.
metrics: Compute BLEU1-4, METEOR, ROUGE-L, CIDEr for raw and exact-sentence-deduplicated captions. Apply exactly same cleanup to both arms.
